prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: tile-riverbank, one hexagonal world-map terrain tile for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game.
Input images: Image 1 is our original unit-a-painted; use it only as a reference for hand-painted brushwork, thin dark outlines, matte material rendering, subdued light and dark muted palette. Do not include its character or equipment.
Primary request: Exactly one clearly six-sided hexagonal world-map terrain tile depicting a muddy riverbank with reeds. The terrain top is a readable contiguous hex footprint, with a shallow silt-dark river along one side, irregular wet mud and small reed clumps along the waterline. Muddy bank dominates; weathered earth and brown-olive reeds, restrained grey-blue water. No structures, bridges, people or animals.
Style/medium: Hand-painted 2D raster, economical brushwork and matte surfaces matching variant A. Thin dark contour at the hex perimeter and restrained reed outlines, strong terrain silhouettes; not photorealistic, pixel art, vector or a glossy 3D render.
Composition/framing: Square 512x512 final frame, one large centered hex footprint nearly fills width, all six vertices visible with slight padding. Three-quarter top-down orthographic camera pitched down about 30 degrees, consistent with sprite-based 2.5D units. Compact world-map top-surface tile, no towering chunk of floating earth, no thick slab or pedestal, no distant horizon. The complete square frame is opaque and painted, with a plain dark muted charcoal ground surrounding the hex. No transparency or chroma key. Terrain readable as one hex rather than a circular island or a rectangular landscape.
Lighting/mood: Soft upper-left light, grim overcast marsh mood, subtle highlights on wet mud and water.
Constraints: Original design only. Do not imitate Battle Brothers, Heroes of Might and Magic, any existing game or artist. No text, letters, labels, logos, borders resembling UI, map coordinates or watermarks. Produce one image only.
